classification.CERTIFIED: native proof complete, independent replay pass, common collision/contact pass, progress lower bound meets target
classification.INVALID_OR_IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE: binding or execution defect; no method conclusion
classification.UNKNOWN: proof or predicate does not establish the target without treating it as unsafe

common_target.collision: full closed hold against static circle center (1/2,1/10), radius 3/50
common_target.contact: full closed hold algebraic contact reserve nonnegative
common_target.primary_criterion: set of actions with replayed full-hold collision/contact and progress lower bound >= 7/20
